entries.title: Quiz says how its question counts fit together
entries.body: The Quiz's information card labels its total as the number of questions "in all". When "Only what I've read" leaves some questions out, the explanation appears beside the count for the question you are on, even with the list of questions closed. Each count was true before, but nothing said how they related.

entries.title: A faulty reply no longer reads as empty
entries.body: When a panel beside the article checked for fresh content and got back a faulty reply, it could treat it as nothing having been made yet and discard what was on screen. Quiz, Citations, Plain words, Ideas, FAQ, Timeline, Debate, Glossary and Quotes check the reply before replacing anything, and report an error instead.

entries.title: Wide tables can be reached from the keyboard
entries.body: When a table is too wide for its window, as your library can be in a narrow one, the Tab key stops on it. In Safari a table that scrolls sideways could not be reached from the keyboard, so anyone not using a mouse or trackpad could not get to the columns out of view.
